usageNotes: Call this before initiating a QEMU VM migration to check whether the migration is feasible — it returns local disks, local resources that block migration, allowed/disallowed target nodes, and HA affinity dependencies. If `local_resources` is non-empty the migration will be blocked; resolve those passthrough devices first. Supply `target` to get node-specific blocking details such as unavailable storages or HA conflicts.

examples.summary: Check migration preconditions for VM 105 on remote 'pve-hetzner', targeting node 'pve2'

tips: A non-empty `local_resources` array means the VM cannot be live-migrated without detaching those resources (e.g. USB passthrough, PCIe devices).

`local_disks` lists CD-ROM ISOs and unused volumes that must be accounted for; ISOs on local storage are not automatically transferred and will block migration unless the target has the same ISO available.
`dependent-ha-resources` will be moved to the same target node automatically — confirm the target can host them before proceeding.
If `has-dbus-vmstate` is false, connection-tracking state (conntrack) will not survive the migration; plan for brief session drops on stateful services.
`allowed_nodes` is omitted when `target` is not specified — pass `target` to get the full node-specific feasibility breakdown in `not_allowed_nodes`.
